items.name: BAL studies (cell count, culture, cytology)

Chest X-ray, portable
items.default: Lungs clear. No effusion or pneumothorax. Normal cardiomediastinal silhouette. Lines and tubes: none.

items.name: CT chest without contrast
items.default: No consolidation, mass or effusion. No pneumothorax.

items.name: CT angiogram chest (PE protocol)
items.default: No pulmonary embolism. No acute thoracic abnormality.

items.name: CT abdomen/pelvis with contrast
items.default: No acute abdominal or pelvic abnormality.

items.name: CT neck soft tissue with contrast
items.default: No airway narrowing, abscess or mass.

items.name: Bedside lung ultrasound (POCUS)
items.default: Bilateral lung sliding, A-line pattern, no B-lines, no effusion.

items.name: Bedside echo (POCUS, limited)
items.default: Normal LV and RV size and function. No pericardial effusion. IVC 1.8 cm, ~40% collapsibility.

items.name: Transthoracic echocardiogram (formal)
items.default: LVEF 60%. Normal RV size and function. No significant valvular disease. No pericardial effusion.

items.name: 12-lead ECG
items.default: Sinus rhythm, normal axis, normal intervals, no acute ST changes.

items.name: Ventilator setting change
items.default: Instructor will apply the requested settings.

items.default: Measured on the vent — see monitor.

items.default: Measured on the vent — see monitor.

items.name: Endotracheal intubation (RSI)
items.default: Intubated. Instructor will confirm tube position and post-intubation status.

items.default: Given — instructor may ask which agents.
